title: Progetto Pico / Pico Project: Oratio de hominis dignitate (Brown University and University of Bologna)
institution: Brown University (Department of Italian Studies) and University of Bologna
author: Giovanni Pico della Mirandola
notes: Hypertext edition of Pico's Oratio (the 'Discourse on the Dignity of Man'), with a transcription of the Latin text of the first printed edition (Bologna, 1496) divided into paragraphs 1-47, an annotated text with commentary by seven scholars, and introductions in Latin, Italian and English. The incunable copies (Exemplar Brunense, Exemplar Bononiense, editio princeps) and the Apologia (1487) are shown as page images only. The original address (brown.edu/Departments/Italian_Studies/pico/) now returns a 404 error, so the link goes to the Internet Archive copy of 13 September 2025. Counts are ours: about 7,700 words of Latin text on the Wayback copy of oratio.html (section numbers included), one work.
